elements.evidence: "grants to Licensee, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Licensee's behalf a non-exclusive license"

elements.element: Licence extends to contractors acting on Customer's behalf
elements.evidence: "its contractors acting on Licensee's behalf"; restriction (e) now permits "employees ... of its contractors acting on Licensee's behalf"
Grant remains "provided that Licensee makes payments to Licensor as required under this Agreement"; no perpetuity language added
No "irrevocable" wording anywhere in the redlined grant

elements.element: Subscription licences terminable only for uncured material breach
elements.evidence: No termination standard inserted; grant stays "subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement"
No assignment/successor language; licence remains a bare "non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology"
"grants to Licensee, its Affiliates" — coverage granted outright, exceeding notice-conditioned coverage

elements.element: Transferable to a successor in an M&A transaction
elements.evidence: No transfer/successor/M&A wording in the operative text; only the margin comment discusses alternatives

offending_extra_words: (with Licensee remaining responsible for each such Affiliate's and contractor's compliance with this Agreement)
reasons: Locked target is preferred, but the redline only addresses Affiliate/contractor scope. Perpetual and irrevocable paid-up licences, termination limited to uncured material breach, and transferability to successors are all absent from the operative text, so the preferred level is incomplete.
The fallback is also incomplete: Affiliate coverage is achieved (indeed exceeded), but no successor/M&A transfer right was inserted, and pieces of preferred and fallback cannot be combined.

Minimality fails: the inserted parenthetical "(with Licensee remaining responsible for each such Affiliate's and contractor's compliance with this Agreement)" adds a new Licensee obligation benefiting Licensor and is not needed to complete the level; the operative check also records both operations breaching the expansion and changed-character limits (2.44x, 1.88x, 0.638 changed characters). A tighter edit (e.g., inserting only ", its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Licensee's behalf") would suffice.

Intent is impaired by a residual contradiction: restriction (b) still bars Licensee from permitting "the use or access of any Licensed Technology by, any third party for any reason without the prior written consent of Licensor", which conflicts with the new grant to contractors (and arguably Affiliates); (b) should be carved back or the grant expressed as notwithstanding (b).

Recommended fix: keep the concise scope insertion, drop the compliance parenthetical, carve contractors/Affiliates out of (b), and add short operative wording for perpetual/irrevocable paid-up licences, breach-only termination, and transfer to a successor.
